How We Work  /  Our Approach

The technology keeps changing. What guides the work does not.

Most technology help fails for the same reason: the work gets done, but nobody is left who understands it. The account is in a consultant's name, the password is in a consultant's head, and the next problem starts from zero.

We work the other way around, and four values decide how. They are the same on a laptop repair and on a multi-year public contract.

What guides us

The same on a home visit and on a county contract.

  1. 01 Technical excellence. The work has to be right. We would rather take an extra day and hand you something that holds up than hit a date with something that will need doing again next year.
  2. 02 Integrity. We are transparent about what we are doing, what it will cost, and what we do not know. If we get something wrong, you hear it from us first.
  3. 03 We let the work speak. We do not upsell. We would rather you buy less, get what you needed, and call us again than buy more and quietly regret it.
  4. 04 Service, all the way through. We fit how you already operate — your mission and values, your compliance and funder requirements, your approval process. Being easy to work with is part of the job, not a courtesy on top of it.

What every engagement includes

Notes you keep

Passwords, accounts, and what we changed — documented in plain language and handed to you.

One person

You talk to the person doing the work. No tiers, no tickets, no repeating your story.

No lock-in

Everything is in your name and under your control. If you leave, nothing has to be untangled.

Why us

You're the destination, not a stepping stone

We are not building a portfolio on small clients so we can go chase bigger ones. This is the work we want.

We know the value of a dollar, and how to stretch it

Our team has worked in some of the lowest-resource settings in the world and with bootstrapped nonprofits running on fumes. Doing more with less is not a slogan here, it is where we learned the job.

We advocate for you with vendors

Small organizations get pushed around by their software companies. We make a forceful, well-documented case on your behalf, so vendors treat you like their biggest customer. That is leverage you do not have alone.

We hand you the keys

We document what we do and build your team's ability to run it without us. That means you could take our documentation and hire someone cheaper next time. Most consultants have every reason not to work that way. We think it is the only honest way to work.

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
